description: Each country's reference inflation, a long-run figure for its consumer prices: the inflation target its central bank publishes (the middle of a range), or, without one, about the 2015–2024 average of consumer price inflation (World Bank, FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG). Typed by hand from the central banks' pages and checked in September 2026; recentAverage marks countries whose prices rose 10% a year or more on average in 2015–2024. Used only to turn growth after rising prices into growth before them; the user can overwrite it.
note: Typed by hand. A central bank's numeric target where it publishes one (the ECB's 2% in the euro area; the middle of a range); otherwise about the 2015–2024 average of consumer price inflation (World Bank, FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG; each such figure was checked against the official series, within one point). The only figure of the cost-of-living data not read from an official series: phase A3 of the Horalis plan decides how to keep it.
